notes.title: [Patch Notes] August 21, 2025
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

The Bless Unleashed PC team is pleased to inform you that server maintenance has been successfully completed. You can now log back into the game and continue your journey.

We truly appreciate your patience and support during this downtime.

Here’s what’s included in today’s update:

Updates

New items in the Mall: 

Occult Priest Costume Box

God's Tear Treasure Chest

Magic BeadTreasure Chest

Growth Crystal Treasure Chest

Known issue (to be fixed):

God's Tear Treasure Chest，Magic BeadTreasure Chest，Growth Crystal Treasure Chest

Unable to list on the exchange

   

Other optimizations:	

Class balance adjustments: Optimize the damage effect of the Ranger's Lightning Arrow; the damage of the small Lightning Arrow will be appropriately reduced.

Increase the number of unbinding times for the Dawn series off-hand equipment and the Ruin series equipment by 1 on the original basis.

Expand the quest trigger range in the "Vachel" area on the map.

Adjust the Bless effect

For the Crusader Guard, the "Powerful Shout" damage of the Valor Blessing is increased.

For the Assassin, the Mark of the Wolf Blessing will trigger the damage buff in PVE regardless of whether the target is stunned (PVP remains unchanged).

BUG Fixes:

Fix the calculation error in the mount compendium's bonus to the character's attack power.

Fix the issue where the Colorful Runes fails to take effect in certain cases.

Fix the problem where the name of level 50 equipment displayed in the crafting list is inconsistent with the actual crafted name.

Thank you for your understanding and support. If you encounter any issues in the game, please don't hesitate to contact us.



- VALOFE Bless Unleashed Team

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/f13ec33b855e4b210db0a002acc18baeb8a94402.jpg
Dear Adventurers,

This is the Bless Unleashed PC team.
The server maintenance is now complete, and you may log in to the game. Thank you for your patience.

The following is a summary of the maintenance update:

Release Notes
1. Server Maintenance: Routine server maintenance was performed.
2. Event Conclusion: The "Early Spring Blossoms" New Year event has concluded.
3. Accessory Refresh Event Conclusion: The accessory refresh event has ended.

4. Damage Statistics Feature Implementation:
---• The damage statistics feature is now available after activating the advanced God Bless welfare function.
---• The damage statistics panel can be toggled on/off via the "Home" button.
---• Currently supported statistics include damage dealt to World Bosses, Area Bosses, and Dungeon Bosses.

5. Refinement Stone Stacking Optimization:

---• The stack limit for refinement stones has been increased from 200 to 800.
---• Refinement stone exchange has been added to the General Merchant.

6. Pet Skill Optimization and Revision

Pet Skill Book Adjustments:
---• Original pet skill books will no longer be obtainable, and existing skill books cannot be upgraded.
---• New pet skill books have a 5% drop chance from the third and subsequent stages of Dimensional Dungeons upon first completion.

Pet Skill Slot Adjustments: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/0fdd38f8ef5c0690890f2ac2745745151aeb4ea0.png

Pet Skill Enhancement Items Added to Lumina Shop:
---• Four-Leaf Clover: Increases pet skill enhancement probability by 3%; usable for upgrading from level 1 to level 2.
---• Lucky Flower: Increases pet skill enhancement probability by 2%; usable for upgrading from level 2 to level 3.
---• Lucky Crystal: Increases pet skill enhancement probability by 2%; usable for upgrading from level 3 to level 4.

Pet Skill Book and Usage Instructions
Skill Book and Skill Descriptions: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/0173cf0259ddc4a7a4990f93d8583ced93fb9855.png


Skill Book Learning Instructions:
[olist]
 The success rate for pet skill learning is 100%.
 Learning a skill will occupy a pet skill slot. If the skill slots are full, a randomly selected skill will be overwritten.
 Skill overwrite priority: Same type lower-level skill -> empty skill slot -> random overwrite of other skills.
 Pet skills must be upgraded sequentially; higher-level skills cannot be learned directly.
 Lower-level skills may overwrite higher-level skills.
 The same skill cannot be learned twice.
[/olist]

Skill Book Enhancement Instructions:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/a124920b7e8816a9eb7dda5158017577bb263355.png

notes.title: [Patch Notes] January 23, 2025
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/f13ec33b855e4b210db0a002acc18baeb8a94402.jpg

Release Notes
• Routine server maintenance.
• Adjustment to the display of equipment, wings, and costumes. When equipping wings and costumes, all weapons will be hidden in non-combat states.
• Fixed a bug where the Priest's Divine Punishment skill failed to restore energy. The energy restoration effect of Divine Punishment is now only effective on the currently selected target.
• Fixed a bug where the Mage's attack speed being too high resulted in a probability of failing to restore magic crystals.
• Adjusted the Priest's "Blade of Punishment" skill. A damage internal cooldown has been added; only one instance of damage can be inflicted within 0.5 seconds.
• Fixed a character deformation issue with the "Vampire Count" costume in the third-person perspective.
• New costumes added to the Lumena Shop: "Classic Cheongsam Costume Chest" costumes.
• Sacred Altar lottery discount event.
• New Year Event commenced.
---• New Year Buff Event: January 28, 0:00 – February 3, 0:00 CST
---• New Year Login Rewards: Available for logins between January 28 and February 2.
---• New Year Cumulative Spending Event: From the completion of maintenance on January 23 to before maintenance on February 6.
---• New Year Limited-Time Accessory Refresh Event: From the completion of maintenance on January 23 to before maintenance on February 20.
---• New Year Event: Early Spring Blossoms
------• Event Period: From the completion of maintenance on January 23 to before maintenance on February 20.
------• Event Method: Obtain a certain number of "Early Spring Blossoms" upon completion of normal or time-limited dungeons.
------• Exchange items with the NPC "Garden Artist Lilith" located west of the Noble District in Spezia North and by Lake Os.

Thank you for your understanding and support. If you encounter any issues in the game, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Valofe Bless Unleashed Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/f13ec33b855e4b210db0a002acc18baeb8a94402.jpg

Release Notes
[olist]
 Server Refresh
 Bingo Event Ended
 Removed the discounted 1 Million Star Seed Box in the Lumena Shop.
 "Character Server Transfer Scroll" is added to the Lumena Shop.
[/olist]

Character Cross-Server Transfer Scroll
1. When a character is transferred, it will be moved to the new server, and all character and item data from the original server will be deleted. Each transfer requires one "Character Transfer Scroll."

2. During the character transfer process, it is also possible to transfer potential and mounts. Please note that if you choose to transfer potential and mounts, they will overwrite any existing potential and mounts on the destination server.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/6d90f889879810bf0c0f16b266bb55e62c244ace.png

3. Utilizing a "Character Transfer Scroll" does not result in an immediate transfer. Instead, the request will be recorded and processed during the next maintenance period. If you mistakenly set the transfer destination or other options during this process, please contact us for assistance.
   • Please be aware that once the transfer is completed, it cannot be reversed.

4. A character that has been transferred cannot be returned to its original server.

5. During the transfer, only items from the character's inventory and warehouse will be moved to the new server. Items in the post, marketplace, account warehouse, and premium inventory will not be transferred; therefore, we kindly ask you to retrieve these items in advance.

Thank you for your understanding and support. If you encounter any issues in the game, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Valofe Bless Unleashed Team

 Bingo Board is in the form of 5*5

 When you complete any row of numbers in the horizontal, vertical and diagonal lines, you will complete a Bingo line, and the more lines you complete, the better the rewards you can receive
 Rewards are divided into 5 stages: 
Stage 1: 1-2 Bingo Lines
Stage 2: 3-4 Bingo Lines
Stage 3: 5-7 Bingo Lines
Stage 4: 8-11 Bingo Lines
Stage 5: 12 Bingo Lines
which corresponds to different Bingo Stage Reward Boxes
 You can only get the Bingo Rewards Box for the corresponding stage.
 You can choose to fill up the Bingo Board or complete any number of Bingo lines to exchange the rewards; after receiving the rewards, the Bingo Board will be refreshed and reset

Note: If you are unable to refresh the Bingo Board or get a digital exception message, please sync the data and try again.

Greetings Adventurers

Content:
Fixed the abnormal movement of the Female Assassin
New Pet system launch. Pet will grant more stats and help you automatically loot dropped items

How to acquire the Pet: Currently, you can earn Pet Chests in the milestone Rewards (e.g. 300/750 points) by accumulating online hours, and opening the chests will randomly award you with Pet (1/2).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/dc4508070d87cc27ffef61e552a0e405e7950cc4.png

Pet Level up: When you obtain a Pet, you can choose to equip it by opening the Backpack -> Pet interface. When you equip a Pet it will also gain EXP

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/a189755740c38ff197a3090cefcc54cf2fbdcda1.png

Pet stats: When you obtain a Pet, the Pet will get random stats, and when you reach a certain level, you can activate the Pet's stats. its main stats can be granted to the character's stats, while the secondary Pet can only get experience, and can't grant its stats to your character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/9c9a5ab722736d25f0b410b5d5e2a057bc5d1ae6.png

Pet Upgrade: When a Pet reaches the cap level of this stage, it can be upgraded by using 2 Pet materials, and the Pet quality will be also upgraded.

- Pet stats Upgrade object will be upgraded to a higher-quality pet based on its original stats, and its new Pet stats will be randomly obtained.
- Material: Add the consumed Pet for the current Pet Upgrade, the Material will disappear after the Pet Upgrade.
- Upgrade: After completing the upgrade, Pet's cap level and stats will be upgraded. Upgrade 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/c5357ecf7234319082dce49959a5d5d8b3e590fc.png

Pet Mix: When your Pet reaches the max level, you can use 2 Pets for Pet Mix, the Mixed Pet will not be upgraded in terms of quality, but it will have random appearance with random stats. You can also obtain a rare appearance through this Pet mix.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ef3e3e127a57000a31e42a155e2a84c42d289d4b.png

Pet Appearance Change: Consume the Appearance to change an existing Pet to look like the Appearance Pet, and the stats of which will not be changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/e7339d7d02d3f1531efd5b7a3da704f2959ad7ed.png

notes.title: Patch Notes and Update + Known Issues - November 29th (PST)
notes.notes:
Greeting Adventurers,

The November Update we introduced in the Roadmap has been performed through the patch today.
Check out a variety of update news of the world of Bless Unleashed including new systems and equipment.

Together with the update, some issues found in the Bless Unleashed PC have also been fixed.
Please check out the details below.



■ New Update

1. Added “Regrant Runes” function.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/b5c3b449fe78489b54f6ea1f9a8baa1f05961a71.png
- Runes can be regranted through the Equipment Specialist NPC.
- A certain amount of “Alchemy Stone” and “Star Seed” are required for regranting Runes, and it requires a different amount according to the tier of the target equipment.
- Alchemy Stone that is required for regranting can be obtained from salvaging S or S+ items.
- After regranting Runes, you can decide or cancel the change according to the result.


2. Added Potential System.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/7316d06569dd0bb17bdad509e7be678a509cfdd6.png
1) Added “Potential” menu in the Player menu.
- You can equip and unequip the current Potential cores.
- When equipping the cores, the effects of the equipped cores will be applied. 
- Potential cores and applying them are shared in an account on a server.

2) Potential cores can be obtained from “Ancient Altar” > “Potential”.
- One chance to use Superior Potentialer for free is given a day.
- Drawing 5 Fragments in “Superior Potentialer” can be used at a 50% discounted price once a week.

3) Potential cores can be fused through the Fusion Specialist NPC.
- A higher-grade Potential cores can be obtained from a fusion of Potential cores.
- Regardless of the fusion target and materials, the result of the fusion is random.


3. Added “Dimensional Dungeon”.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/1d6e6d1803782acceadebcad7190a354092325f5.png
- A Dimensional Dungeon is stronger than the other dungeons and consists of 10 phases.
- The difficulty is higher for a higher phase, and various effects are given to the player and monsters in each phase.
- Like Time Dungeons, Dimensional Dungeons can only be accessed during a specific time period, with each Dungeon on its own schedule.
- “Dimensional Stone” can be obtained from completing Dimensional Dungeons.
- Using the Dimensional Stones, rare products can be purchased from “Dimensional Stone Trade Merchant”, a Golden Key Traders Member.

▶ Dimensional Stone Trade Merchant 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/37627a7f25d0be8b3f4f619a017bf6c851f42c7c.png
 

4. Added “Ancient” grade, the next grade of “Mythic”.
- +5 Mythic equipment can be upgraded to the “Ancient” grade.
- Only S+ equipment can be upgraded and enhanced to the “Ancient” grade.
 

5. Added new accessories, enhancement materials and Ancient weapon materials.
- Added 22 necklaces and 22 rings with Lv.35 and Lv.40.
- These new items can be obtained from “Dimensional Dungeon Reward Chest” and “Dimensional Stone Trade Merchant”.
 
[New Accessories’ Effects]
1) Increases Damage +12~20%(Mythic) / 20~30%(Ancient) but also increases Received Damage +20%.
2) Upon damaging an opponent with a Critical Hit, Attack Power increases +80~120(Mythic) / 120~140(Ancient) and Critical Hit Damage +2.4~3.3%(Mythic) / 3.3~4.2%(Ancient) for 30 sec according to the number of your dice roll. The chance of rolling is 20%. (Cooldown: 60 sec)
3) Damage increases +12~18%(Mythic) / 18~25%(Ancient) when HP is at 50% or below.
4) Increases Critical Hit Rate +12~18%(Mythic) / 18~25%(Ancient) but decreases Critical Hit Damage -35%.
5) Inflicts additional damage equal to 3,500~4,500%(Mythic) / 4,500~5,500%(Ancient) of Attack Power after landing 5 Critical Hits. (Cooldown: 60 sec)
6) Increases Attack Power +6~10%(Mythic) / 10~15%(Ancient), but decreases Attack Speed -15%.
7) Damage increases +5~8%(Mythic) / 8~12%(Ancient) for 15 sec when rolling. (Max. 5 stacks / Buff is cancelled after the first attack)
8) Increases Attack Power +25~35(Mythic) / 35~50(Ancient) for each level.
9) Upon damaging the target, grants a buff to party members within 5 m radius that increases their attack speed +5~7%(Mythic) / 7~10%(Ancient) for 10 sec. (Cooldown: 10 sec)
10) Inflicts Defense -5~10%(Mythic) / 10~15%(Ancient) reduction debuff on target for 10 sec upon damaging the target.
11) Inflicts Received Damage +5~8%(Mythic) / 8~12%(Ancient) debuff on target for 10 sec upon damaging the target.
 
※ Critical Hit Damage is not decreased to below 130%.
 
[Setting Method of New Accessories’ Effects]
- The first option of new accessories is fixed, but the second and third effects are decided according to the color of Runes.
  ㄴ Red Rune:  Increases Attack Power / Reduces Potion Cooldown / Increases PvP Attack Power / Increases Attack Speed
  ㄴ White Rune:  Increases Critical Hit Rate / Increases Critical Hit Damage / PvP Defense / Decreases chance of receiving Critical Hit Damage
  ㄴ Green Rune:  Increases Amount of HP Restored / Increases Max HP
  ㄴ Yellow Rune:  Increases Increases Artifact Core Gain from salvaging / Increases PvE XP Gain / Increases PvE Gold Gain
  ㄴ Purple Rune:  Randomly applies one of the effects above.
 

6. Added S+ Battlefield Equipment.
- Added “Crimson Mercenary” weapons and armors, new S+ equipment that can be purchased at Sen/Vos’Elan Faction Merchant using Victory Tokens.
 
7. “Empire’s Unbinding Scroll”, an unbinding scroll for S and S+, is available at Limited Merchant.
- “Empire’s Unbinding Scroll” unbinds S and higher-tier equipment.
- “Empire’s Unbinding Scroll” can be purchased with 85 Alchemy Stones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/1460a21e76658e437adcfc949d39ac38f5a71a97.png
 
 
8. Ancient Weapons can be upgraded to S+ through crafting.
- Increased the attack power increase effect, the [Hero's Will] effect of S-tier Ancient weapons, from 83 to 140.
- Added a transcendence function for Ancient Weapons.
ㄴ S+ Ancient Weapon can be obtained from transcending an Ancient Weapon.
- Transcending Ancient Weapons is available at The Smith Magras.
- When transcending an Ancient Weapon, the Runes of the Ancient Weapon are regranted.
 
9. Added an option to automatically decline the challenges for a Duel.
- Added “Decline Duel” option to Menu > Settings > Gameplay.
- The default setting is on.
 
10. Added a ‘Wing Costume’ slot.
 
 

■ Patch Details

[System]
1. Changed so that if changing to another skill after using the skill with buff effect, the changed buff effect is removed.
2. Changed some Attendance rewards.

[Before]
 Day 3 - Card: Jungle Safari Hat
 (Week 1) Completion Reward - Card: Explorer's Trusty Stallion
 Day 7 - Card: Jungle Safari Outfit


[After]
 Day 3 - Card: Tea Time Hat
 (Week 1) Completion Reward - Card: Tricolor Kid
 Day 7 - Card: Tea Time Outfit


3. Changed the reward of [Streak 750 Min] in Attendance.

[Before]
- Artifact Core Pouch (Lesser) : 200 Artifact Cores

[After]
- Attendance Artifact Core Box : Obtain one of 500/600/700 Artifact Cores at random according to a fixed rate.


[Quest]
1. Changed the available days and the reset cycle of the prestige quest in each region.
- Changed so that some regional quests that had 3-hour duration now have 1-day duration.
- Changed so that regardless of the objective type(Exploration, Gathering, Hunting, Repairing) of a prestige quest, it will be completed if a regional quest is completed.
- Removed the resetting objectives function of a prestige quest.

[Before]
- Available Day for the Quest : No limit
- Reset Day : Every Monday

[After]
- Available Day for the Quest : Certain day per region
- Reset Day : Every certain day per region

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ade03377c61010871fe85ebfa31b541ca441c02c.png

※ Notes
1. Reward will be changed on November 29th, 2021, and the Prestige quest is not available after the “Available Day”.
2. Please take note that a Prestige quest will be reset every certain day per region.


[Fixed Bugs]
- Fixed a bug where players couldn’t proceed to Matchmaking anymore after they failed in the Matchmaking area due to the loading screen, death, Telepost transfer, etc. during a Party Matchmaking.
- Fixed the incorrect description of the class restriction-related message displayed when 5 players with the same class request a 5-Players Dungeon as follows.
* The class limit has been exceeded. There cannot be more than 4 players of the same class in a dungeon, or 2 players of the same class in the Arena.
- Fixed a bug where S-tier Ancient Weapons couldn’t be traded even after unbinding them.


[November 29th - Known Issues]
- The causes of the known issues have been identified and will be fixed through a later patch.

◆ There is an issue in the Marketplace where if the number of item types registered in the Purchase tab is 16 or higher, it shows as if only 15 items are listed.


We will continue to do our best in providing the best gameplay experience.
This announcement will be updated or a new announcement will be made if additional updates are available.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 17th (PST)
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

A server patch was performed at around November 17th, 16:00 (PST) / November 18th, 01:00 (CET) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.


■ Patch Notes

[Berserker]
■ Blessing
1. The Crescent Moon
    1) Raging Hunger
- Decreased the cooldown and the Decreased Vitality of “Rage: Extinction” by 25% ~ 85% and the charge time by 50%.
- If hit with fully-charged “Rage: Extinction”, the attack speed is increased by 15% for 15 seconds and the attack power is increased by 50% ~ 150%.

    2) Suppress Pain
- Charges “Coercion” up to 2 times.
- Attacking an enemy with “Coercion” while Raging Hunger and Blood Leech effect are applied extends the Raging Hunger and Blood Leech effect by 0.7 ~ 4 seconds for each hit enemy. This effect is only applied to 3 ~ 5 targets at once.

    3) Overcome Pain
- Attacking an enemy while Blood Leech effect is applied has 27.5% ~ 100% chance to decrease the cooldown of Warcry-type skills by 2 seconds.
- Hitting an enemy under the movement speed decrease effect with fully-charged “Rage: Extinction” stuns the enemy for 2 ~ 3 seconds.

    4) Imposing
- Increased the damage of Warcry-type skills by 20% ~ 100% and the Defense by 225 ~ 5000.

■ Skills
- Blood Leech: Added an effect where the amount of recovered HP is increased according to the upgrade level.
           * Fixed the effect where Critical Hit under Blood Leech recovers HP too much so that the recovery amount is twice than the default amount.
- Coercion: Adjusted the divided damage that applies when attacking multiple enemies and increased the AOE damage.
- Rage: Extinction: Adjusted the divided damage that applies when attacking multiple enemies and increased the AOE damage.


[Marketplace]
- Adjusted the maximum price limit in the Marketplace for some items.
- Fixed a bug where both registered and non-registered items are displayed in the Purchase tab of Marketplace.


[Fixed Bugs]
- As salvaging the Celebrity Ensemble and Novice Uniform Costume Card provides lower amount of “Outfit Options Scroll” than their value, adjusted so that 30-34% more amount can be obtained.

We will continue to do our best in providing the best gameplay experience.

■ New Update


[Dungeon] 

[previewyoutube=n7vF9r89X78;full][/previewyoutube]

 Rutus Mines - Halls of the Dead

 You can challenge 4 difficulty levels in Battlefield / Warlords Arena.

- Weekly mission is reset every sunday at 18:00 (PDT).

▶ PVP Season Rank
- PvP Rank consists of [Battlefield Rank] and [Arena Rank].
- The rank is changed according to the play result of Battlefield / Warlords Arena during the season.
- Battlefield/Arena Rank is reset after the season period.

▶ Conditions of PVP Rank-up

º Battlefield (15vs15)
- Battlefield XP can be obtained according to the match result.
- Battlefield Rank is increased according to the accumulation of the Battlefield XP.

* Battlefield Rank
Apprentice -> Combatant -> Veteran -> Ace -> Master -> Legend 


º Warlords Arena (3vs3)
- Rank score can be obtained according to the match result.
- If you win the match, a certain score will be obtained and the rank can be increased.
- According to the match result, the Arena rank score is changed.

* Arena Rank
No Grade -> Barbarian -> Brawler -> Fighter -> Destroyer -> Ruler -> Immortal


▶ PVP Season Special Reward
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/c19820aeae549c9c7d50538406b615bc627695c2.png
- A rare title can be obtained by achieving a high rank in Battlefield / Warlords Arena during the season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ef343e52a472f47deb35cf6949dcfb13e31ac079.png

 Non-adjusted Stats: Options of equipped gears, Skills, Bless effects

- You can have a “1vs1 duel” challenge with other players through an interaction.

* During the 1vs1 Duel, “Notoriety” doesn’t increase by attacking each other.

1. Bag and Warehouse have a separated tab where only materials can be stored.
When you obtain a material item or store it in the Warehouse, the item will first be stored in the “Material” tab of Bag or Warehouse.

2. Changed controls for “Acquiring”, “Registering”, “Upgrading” skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ede4075f50206f5b9d1eaf171e4c1e9a788c3121.png


■ Changes

[Lumena Shop]

1. Added a Clas Breath Drawing product that can be purchased once per week.
- You can draw up to 10 times, and it’s guaranteed to obtain 3 Epic Breaths for your class.

2. Added new products in Lumena Shop.
- Arctic Officer's Visor/Uniform Chest
- Celebrity Shades/Ensemble Chest
- Behemoth Mount
- Neglected Armored Strider Mount
- Time Dungeon Reward Booster


[Crusader]

■ Blessing

1) Gift of Valor
: Charge-type has been removed and Dauntless Charge-type and Daring Assault-type skills are categorized to Strike-type skills.

- Brave Assault
: The effect that reduces the cooldown of Charge-type skills has been replaced by an effect that reduces the cooldown of Strike-type skills.

- The Eternal Warrior
: The effect that increases the damage of Charge-type skills has been replaced by an effect that increases the damage of Strike-type skills.

2) Mark of the Wolf
- Fang of the Wolf
: Increased the damage of Bleeding by twice.

- Howl of the Wolf
: Increased the duration of Excess Bleeding as well as Bleeding when using Shout-type skills.

- Razor Claw 
: Increased the damage of Excess Bleeding by 6.5 times.

3) The Lionheart
- Roar of the Lion 
: Increased the damage of Shout-type skills from 160%~320% to 224%~448% of Attack Power.

- Shout 
: Increased the damage increase of Warcry, Great Slash, and Spinning Slash combo while Shout-type effect is activated from 20%~120% to 24%~144%.

■ Fixed Bugs
- Fixed a bug of The Crescent Moon Blessing’s “Armed Frontline” where the damage increase of Counterattack was not applied.


[Berserker]

■ Blessing
1) The Lionheart
- Beast Lord's Attack
: Slightly increased the duration of “Attack Warning” from 3~15 to 4~15 second and the duration of “Beast Lord's Attack” from 4.5~14 to 5~14 seconds for the low levels.

- Beast Lord's Advance
: Slightly increased the duration of “Advance Warning” from 3~15 to 4~15 seconds and the duration of “Beast Lord's Advance” from 4.5~14 to 8~24 seconds for the low levels.

- Consecutive Strike
: Increased the duration of “Consecutive Strike” from 3~12.5 to 7~20 seconds.


[Ranger]

■ Blessing
1) Gift of Valor
- Ramming Arrow
: Increased the damage of Tempest Shot from 15% ~ 140% to 37.5% ~ 350%.

- Sharpshooter
: Added an effect where using “Bottomless Quiver” adds 8 stacks of the Flashing effect.

- Neural Stimulation
: Change the condition to reduce the cooldown of “Tempest Shot” from “Each successful combo hit” to “Each successful hit with Rush-type and Double Shot-type combos and skills”.

2) Mark of the Wolf
- Fully Prepared
: Increased the Attack Power increase from holding special arrows from 15% ~ 60% to 17.25% ~ 69%.


3) The Lionheart
- Threat of the Beast 
: Increased the damage increase per stack of Scarred from 3.5% ~ 8% to 4.59% ~ 10.48%.

■ Fixed Bugs
- Fixed a bug where the Lv.5 stats of “Fully Prepared” of “Mark of the Wolf” was not applied correctly.



[Mage]

■ Blessing
1) Gift of Valor
- Frost Circulation
: Changed so that all Frost-type skills are allowed to be charged up, not only Frost Spike.
: Removed the effect where hitting enemies with Frost Nova immediately charges Frost Spike, and added an effect where attacking enemies with Frost-type skills has a certain chance to decrease the cooldown of Arcane-type skills -1 sec.


2) The Lionheart
- Chain Explosion
: Increased the damage increase of Chain Explosion and Meteor from 20 ~ 100% to 28 ~ 138%.

- Madness of Fire 
: Increased the damage increase of Meteor from 20 ~ 100% to 28 ~ 138%.

3) The Crescent Moon
- Elemental Detection
: Increased the damage increase of “Flame Detection” and “Arcane Detection” from 100%~300% to 108%~324%.
: Added an effect where while Detection effect is activated, the cooldown of  the same type skills is decreased by 50%.


 [Priest]

 ■ Class Skill
1) Blades of Justice
- Changed from “Holy Bolt”-type to “Holy Bolt + Smite”-type.

■ Blessing
1) Gift of Valor
- Trance
: Changed the Critical Hit Rate increase from 3.5% to 4%, and Critical Hit Damage increase to 15% per stack.


2) The Lionheart
- Fervor 
: Increased the chance to obtain the effect from 10% ~ 30% to 30% ~ 75%, and increased the Attack Speed increase from 1% to 2.5%.
: Added an effect where activating the Compassion effect again when it is stacked to the maximum limit decreases the cooldown of Smite-type skills -1 sec.

- Executioner 
: The effect that decreases the cooldown of Smite-type skills has been replaced by the effect that increases the Attack Power of Smite-type skills +20%~100%.



 [Item]

■ S Equipment
1. Changed the bound option when obtaining S equipment from [Account Bound] to [Bound]. After bound, S equipment cannot be stored in the Account Warehouse.
- The S equipment that was stored in the Account Warehouse before patch will be bound to the first character that retrieves it.
- The S equipment under an unbound state will still keep the unbound state, and it can be stored in the Account Warehouse or traded.

2. Changed the required item for unbinding S equipment to “Master Unbinding Scroll”.
- Currently, this item cannot be obtained, and obtaining location will be added through the future update.

3. Changed so that when salvaing S equipment at a Soul Pyre, “Alchemy Stone” can additionally be obtained with the original reward.
- “Alchemy Stone” is used during Rune randomization for S or lower equipment.

* Rune Randomization system will be added through the future update.


■ Enhancement 
1. Adjusted so that the enhancement success rate is 100% up to Rare grade, and increased the success rate of up to +2 of Epic, Legendary, Myth.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/805e2f65cea16891845a3673821b1c7b3dc1f078.png

2. Changed so that when the enhancement level is maintained or destroyed, the additional success rate is applied according to the grade of the enhanced equipment.
- Maintained: Uncommon 0.1% / Rare 0.3% / Epic 0.5% / Legendary 0.7% / Myth 1%
- Destroyed: Uncommon 0.3% / Rare 0.9% / Epic 1.5% / Legendary 2.1% / Myth 3%

3. Changed so that Upgrade Stone and Fortification Stone are used during the Unlicensed Enhancement.

4. Decreased the chance to destroy the equipment during the Unlicensed Enhancement to 1/4 of the original rate.


■ Material 
1. Adjusted the balance for Gathering/Mining/Logging.
- The positioning density of Plant, Ore, and Tree objects is lower in the world and respawning interval is random.
- Increased the maximum amount of obtaining items from Gathering/Mining/Logging at once.
- Increased the material reward from a special monster summoned during Gathering/Mining/Logging.
- The effect that increases the amount of obtaining items from Gathering/Mining/Logging by twice(Buff item, Bless effect, Event effect) has been replaced by an effect “Amount of obtained item +1”.

■ Item for Taming Rate
1. Increased the “chance to capture animals” by “Call” item, and adjusted the duration from 30 mins to 10 mins.
2. Increased the “chance to capture animals” by Estate decorations, and adjusted the duration from 1 hour to 30 mins.
 - Applied Estate decorations : 'Maple Tree Swing' , 'Fountain Pool'

[Marketplace]
1. Maximum price limit is applied when listing items in the Marketplace. Items cannot be listed with a higher price than the price limit.
- The maximum price limit varies in items, and “Max. selling price” of each item can be checked in “Sell Item” window.

[Quest]

 Added Aiden Narrative Quest “Preparations” in “Gnoll Wastes”.
 Changed Wanted Quest in “Ruins of Tristezza” to Aiden Reward Quest.
 Added 1 Aiden Reward Quest in “Padana Ruins”.
 Placed Beggar NPC additionally in “Ruins of Tristezza”.
- Like the current Beggar NPCs, you can receive a blessing after showing some mercy.
 Improved the content about “Navarra”.[/olist]

2) Changed the objective of “The King of Navarra” Campaign Quest from “Defeat 3 Gnoll leaders” to “Defeat 1 Gnoll leader”.
3) Changed the quest completion NPC of “Navarran Cuisine” Sidequest from “Merchant Pesoa” to “Cowherd Luis”.
4) Changed so that the Sidequest item of “Gathering Evidence” is also dropped from “Outlaw Swordsman” and “Outlaw Gladiator” not only from “Outlaw Soldier“.
5) Changed the location of the quest accepting NPC of “The Hidden Village” Sidequest from “inside Breezemane Inn” to “in front of the western gate of Navarra City”.
6) Changed so that the “Venomous Varmints” regional quest is not activated in “Outlaw Fortress”.

■ Fishing
1. Removed the existing Fishing tutorial Quest and added a new tutorial Quest.
 - Those players who are doing or completed the “Learning to Fish” quest can also proceed to the new tutorial Quest.
 - Changed so that the Fishing tutorial Quest can be received from “Shabiki Spottedfin Puller” not from “Fishing Tool Merchant”.

2. Additionally placed the “Shabiki Spottedfin Puller” NPC all over the place.


 [UI/UX]
1. Added a feature where when a certain effect is enhanced or triggered by the equipped Blessing, the effect is displayed on the UI.

3. Changed so that some Quest items that were categorized in “Consumables” are now categorized in “Quest Material” and cannot be used.

- Snake Egg
4. Changed the description of [PvP Defense / PvP Attack Power] option effect of some equipment.

 * “PvP Defense” is an option where the damage received from players is reduced, and the description has been changed to “Reduces received PvP damage”.

2) PvP Attack Power -> Increases PvP damage

5. Changed so that Telepost cannot be used when a character is under a combat state.

 [Fixed Bugs]
1. Fixed a bug where when players are on the “In Service of the Crown” quest, the Pathfinding is not shown after changing the objective.
2. Fixed a bug where when male Human race equips the “Supreme Protector” costume, the shoulder armor is not shown properly.

notes.title: [Edited]Preview of Update on October 28th
notes.notes:
Greeting Adventurers,
 
The October update we promised in the “Bless Unleashed PC Update Roadmap” announcement will be performed on October 28th. We believe you are getting more curious as the update is only 1 week away.
 
So, for players who are looking forward to the update, we prepared “Update Preview” about the major new contents and changes of the current contents in October.
 
Since the update is soon, we want to ask for your interest and support.
 
 
 
[New Content Update]
 
1. New 6 Lv.40 Time Dungeons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/981b0ab7ac06f267a49f37a7cf6acf60a0cf4007.png

[Lair Challenge(5 Players): Required Character Level: Lv.40 / Required Gear Score : 1516]
 Harpy Queen's Nest
 Chamber of the Ancient
 Archon of Fire
 Infernal Execution Grounds
- A giant dragon “Elfirkraag” stays in this place.
- The ground here was burnt by the Elfirkraag’s flame.

[Dungeon(5 Players) : Required Character Level: Lv.40 / Required Gear Score : 1516] 
 [Abyssal] Dreamscale Ruins - Hall of the Eclipse
 [Abyssal] Rutus Mines - Halls of the Dead

※ Notes[olist]
 After the update on October 28th, the 6 Lv.40 Time Dungeons will be open in order based on the Time Dungeon schedule.
 As Lv.40 Time Dungeons are added, the whole Time Dungeon schedule will be changed on October 28th.
 The first Lv.40 Time Dungeon you will see is “Infernal Execution Grounds”, Lair Challenge(5 Players).
 The previously announced required Gear score for Lv.40 Time Dungeon, 1574, will be adjusted to 1516.
  S+ Equipment can be obtained from Lv.40 Lair Challenge Dungeon(5 Players).
[/olist]

 ▶ Time Dungeon Schedule of October (Oct. 28th ~ Nov. 3rd)
- Arena Challenges (2 Players)
 The Pagar Champion
 The Fiendlord Executioner

 
- Lair Challenges (5 Players)
 Shadow Visions Lair Challenge
 Infernal Execution Grounds  (Lv.40)

 
- Dungeons (5 Players)

 Rutus Mines - Depths of Corruption 
 The Nightspire - Abyss of Evil

 
- [Abyssal] Dungeons (5 Players)

 [Abyssal] Dreamscale Ruins - Hall of the Eclipse  (Lv.40)
 [Abyssal] Kobold Lair - Infernal Kitchen


▶S+ Equipment
 
[Plate Type]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/323bbc37730468b06b9cbb4fa9a9ebc78c15900b.png
 
[Leather Type]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/4c20d2a687b843feb3a337fb2357ce0f9efd6f22.png
 
[Cloth Types]         
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/1758debc0393461cf3b509bdcf95293a5a6dbec8.png
 
 
2. Twisted Void Soulraiser Revenant
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/5b6093cf3668236774d5033c91f2d86e197bed1f.png
- Appears in North Sperios.
 
 
3. The current Warlords Arena will be changed to a casual mode
- In the casual mode of Warlords Arena, all characters are set to have the same level with basic attack and defense stats of each class.
- But, the option of the current equipment and the status of Blessings and skills will be maintained.
 

4. The official PvP Battlefield Season ‘Rising Dawn’ will start
- Various rewards can be obtained from completing missions through “weekly challenge” and “seasonal challenge”.
- Based on the PvP statistics, you can check your rank and get various rewards and titles.
- Battlefield Rank is given according to your Battlefield ranking.
 

▶ Preview Arena Rank & Battlefield Rank
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/0748e5e4b772cc5ca23b6e8deea190208810d2cc.png
 

4. 1:1 Combat system will be added
- You can have a 1:1 combat with another player regardless of your notoriety.
 

5. Material Storage will be added
- “Material Storage” tab will be added to Storage, so that materials can be stored separately.
 
 

[Revision Update of Current Content]
 
1. There will be changes in Blessings of each class. Check out the details below.
 
[Crusader]
- Gift of Valor: Charge-type skills will be removed and effects related to Charge-type skills will be changed to Strike-type skills.
- Mark of the Wolf: The damage of Excess Bleeding will be increased as well as Bleeding.
- The Lionheart: The damage of Shout-type skills will be increased.
 

[Ranger]
- Gift of Valor: The damage of Tempest Shot will be increased, and Flashing effect will be stacked faster.
- Mark of the Wolf: Having a special arrow will give more power.
- The Lionheart: Scarred effect will be enhanced to give more damage to enemies.
 

[Berserker]
- The Lionheart: When using Shock attacks and Slash attacks, the duration will be increased to maintain stacking with more time.
- The Crescent Moon: Overall improvement will come to let players experience a new combat style after the update on October 28th.
 

[Mage]
- Gift of Valor: Charging effect will be applied to Frost-type skills, and a mechanism where Arcane-type skills can be used more often will be added to use Ice Breaking often.
- The Lionheart: The increased damage by Chain Explosion and Madness of Fire will be enhanced.
- The Crescent Moon: The skill enhanced while the Detection effect is applied will be able to be used more often.
 

[Priest]
- Gift of Valor: Increase of Critical Hit Damage will be added to Trance.
- The Lionheart: The damage will be increased to be faster and more aggressive during a Party play.
- The Crescent Moon: Overall improvement will come to let players experience a new combat style after the update on October 28th.

 
2. The drop rate of S items will be increased and their options will be adjusted.[olist]
 The drop rate of S items will be increased by double from the current rate.
 The options of S(S+) items will be adjusted.
- Bound to character when obtained.
- Requires a new unbinding item. (The item will be available from the update on November)
   ㄴ “Unbinding Scroll” can be used for unbinding A or lower rank equipment.
- Cannot be stored in Account Storage (Can be stored after unbound)
- Bound to character if equipped after unbound.

 The required materials for the “Runes Adjustment” content from the future update can be obtained from salvaging S, S+ items.[/olist]
 
* Binding Conditions for S Equipment before Patch   
- The following binding conditions will apply to the S equipment obtained before the patch.
     
Case 1.  If a bound item is stored in the Account Storage,
: It will be bound to the first character that retrieves the item after the patch.
      
Case 2. For the equipment under an unbound state,
: The unbound state will still be maintained after the patch, and the equipment will be tradable and be able to be stored in the Account Storage.

▶ Dev Comment
Many of S-tier items, the highest tier equipment, are currently obtained from trading not farming. We confirmed that players are losing their motivation for growth because of the high market price of Star Seed. By this, our goal is that players will be able to easily obtain the desired items from a direct game play by lowering the obtaining difficulty compared to before.
 
 
3. Enhancement Rate and Bonus Success Rate will be adjusted.[olist]
 The enhancement success rate will be 100% up to the Rare grade, and the success rate will be increased for Epic, Legendary and up to Mythic +2.
 Bonus Success Rate of “Common Enhancement” and “Unlicensed Enhancement” will be automatically applied by grade, and the bonus rate will be lower in general.
[/olist]
 

4. Others
- The attendance reward will be changed. As the reward is changed, the attendance will be reset.
   ㄴ Rescheduled to the November Update : Due to the change of the schedule, this will apply through the update next month. 
 
 
The details above are major changes and the final update details will be checked in the patch note on October 28th.
 
We are looking forward to your interest and support.
Thank you.

Greetings Adventurers,

We are excited to announce that Bless Unleashed PC’s first update is now live!

This update introduces the new Nightspire Dungeon and Field Boss, Twisted Void Spider Queen, providing a new challenge to even the strongest players. Employ a variety of action combat styles as you take on the diverse patterns of these formidable foes. 
It won’t be easy, but with allies you just might be able to beat it.

In addition to the update, a server patch was also applied in response to previously identified issues.


■ Patch Notes

[New Content]

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 8th (PDT)
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

A server patch was performed at around September 8th, 6PM (PDT) / September 9th, 3AM (CEST) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.



■ Patch Notes

[Crusader]
■ Class Skills
- Zealot's Fire
: “Zealot's Fire” can be disabled if using the skill while it’s activated.

■ Blessings
1) Mark of the Wolf
- Fang of the Wolf
: Increased the max. stack limit of “Bleeding” from 3 times to 8 times.
: Decreased the damage per stack by 25%.

- Razor Claw
: Increased the chance to inflict “Bleeding” while “Zealot's Fire” is active from 15~56% to 35~85%.
: Removed the effect where “Chains of War” causes “Bleeding” by a certain rate. Instead, if inflicting a damage with “Zealot's Fire” to a target with a certain amount of stacks of “Bleeding”, a new bleeding effect “Excess Bleeding” will be applied. The required amount of stacks is decreased according to the growth of “Razor Claw”.

2) The Lionheart
- Roar of the Lion
: Increased the damage of Shout skill from 100~250% of Attack Power to 160~320% of Attack Power.
- Shout
: Increased the damage bonus of Roar, Great Sweeping Slash, Spinning Slash from 20~75% to 20~120%.

- Overwhelming Defense
: The effect can also be triggered when Counterattack skill is used as well as when Shield Block is used.

■ Fixed Bug
- Fixed a bug where the class skill “Righteous Vigor” effect is not activated even on Critical Hit.


[Berserker]
■ Blessings

1) Gift of Valor
- Blade Wind
: Successful hit with Whirlwind skill applies the “Blade Wind” effect to yourself by the same rate as “Bleeding”. “Blade Wind” effect lasts for 20 seconds and can be stacked up to 10 times. Each stack increases the damage of “Whirlwind” by 6.5%.

- Rushing Storm
: Upgraded the mx. stack limit of “Rushing Storm” from 10 times to 1~10 times.
: Added an effect where successful hit with combos reduces the cooldown of “Whirlwind” by a certain rate.

- Eye of the Storm
: Added an effect where the cooldown of “Whirlwind” is reset and “Blade Wind” and “Rushing Storm” are applied when using “Rage”.


[Ranger]
■ Blessings

1) Gift of Valor
- Ramming Arrow
: Changed so that the arrow cost is decreased for Rush-type and Double Shot-type skills not only for “Tempest Shot”.

- Sharpshooter
: Changed so that the Flashing effect can be refreshed even when the effect is stacked to the max. limit.
: Increased the duration of Flashing effect from 10~50 seconds to 20~90 seconds.

- Neural Stimulation
: Changed the effect where Tempest Shot is additionally charged 1 time, so that it’s additionally charged up to 2 times.
: Improved the issue where combos are not triggered when used consecutively. However, this is only applied to the attacks of 0.3 seconds or above, and the improvement for the attacks of below 0.3 seconds will be applied through the future update.

2) The Lionheart
- Threat of the Beast
: Increased the max. stack limit of “Scarred” from 3 times to 5 times.
: Decreased the effect of “Scarred” per stack by 20%.
: Increased the duration of “Scarred” from 5~25 seconds to 7~25 seconds.
: Fixed a bug where “Scarred” was applied to a single target even used to multiple targets at once.

- Encouragement
: Changed so that the Attack Power Reduction effect is activated when “Scarred” is stacked to the max. limit.
: Added an effect where the cooldown of “Bottomless Quiver” is reduced by a certain rate when attacking a target with max. stacks of “Scarred”.

- Sharp Claws
: Increased the chance to additionally cause “Scarred” from 10% to 10~30%.

■ Fixed Bug
-Fixed the description of “Neural Stimulation” of Ranger’s “Gift of Valor” Blessing that states the cooldown of Tempest Shot is reduced by 1 second. Edited from 1 second to 2 seconds, and the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds as before.


[Mage]
■ Blessings

1) The Lionheart
- Chain Explosion
: Increased the default duration of “Chain Explosion” from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.
: Added an effect that increases the damage of “Meteor”.

- Madness of Fire
: Increased the default duration of “Madness of Fire” from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.
: Increased the number of meteors dropped by using “Flame Wave” while “Madness of Fire” is active from 1 to 1~3. 1 meteor at stage 1 of Flame Wave, 2 meteors at stage 2, 3 meteors at stage 3 are dropped.
: Additional 3 meteors are dropped if using “Meteor” while “Madness of Fire” is active.

- Boost Firepower
: Changed the effect of Mana cost reduction from reduction by 100% at Lv.10 to reduction by 100% at Lv.5.
: Add an effect that increases the damage of Flame combos by 50~150%.

- Heart of Fire
: Changed the effect of Mana cost reduction of Flame combos and skills from reduction by 10~40% to reduction by 20~60%.

2) The Crescent Moon
- Chosen by Arcane
: Increased the duration of “Chosen by Arcane” from 7~20 seconds 12~30 seconds.

- Chosen by Flame
: Increased the duration of “Chosen by Flame” from 7~20 seconds 12~30 seconds.

- Elemental Detection
: Increased the duration of “Flame Detection” and “Arcane Detection” from 10 seconds 20 seconds.

■ Fixed Bug
: Fixed a bug where Mage can go through the wall using the “Blinkstrike” skill in some Dungeons.


[Priest]
■ Blessings

1) The Lionheart
- Benediction
: Added an effect that increases the healing amount of Healing Sphere created through Benediction by 20~150%.

- Fervor
: Added an effect increases the attack power by 4% per stack.

2) The Crescent Moon
- Overflow
: Decreased the max. stack limit of “Overflow” from 10 times to 5 times.
: As the max. stack limit is decreased, the effect per stack increased by double.

- Eruption
- Decreased the max. stack limit of “Eruption” from 30 times to 10 times.
- As the max. stack limit is decreased, the effect per stack increased by 3 times.

■ Fixed Bug
- Fixed so that although Priest receives “Shield of Faith” from another player while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is active, “Protection and Sacrifice” effect is properly applied.
- Fixed an issue where Priest’s “Retribution” skill is fired into the air when using it to the monsters around after completing gathering or mining.


[Quest]
- Change the conditions for the Invasion quest of Kannus Mountains, “Creatures of Chaos” to completing “The Cursed Mountain” Crusade quest once and interacting with Suspicious Altar.
- Changed so that “Defeat Bashal” and “Defeat the Harpy Queen” during the class level quest “The Master's Test” can be also completed by defeating a Twisted Boss.


[Dungeon]
- Fixed a bug where after defeating the first boss “Malignis” in the Time Dungeon “The Nightspire - Entropic Descent”, characters cannot move properly on the bridge that appears after activating a Soul Pyre in the second location.
- Changed so that the “Bloodclot” skill of “Plague Titan”, the boss of the Time Dungeon “Forgotten Sewers”, will be removed when the boss is defeated.
- Fixed an issue where the damage of Bleeding effect caused by the attack from “Vasilios”, the boss in the Time Dungeon “[Abyssal] Savantis Mausoleum - Altar of Blood”, is abnormally low.


[UI/UX]
- Removed the unused rewards list button from the Reputation Menu.
- Fixed an issue where Livelihood Blessings are shown under “Combat Blessings” in the Blessings Menu.
- Fixed a bug where Mails are not shown when it becomes the combat mode while Mailbox is opened.
- Improved so that more characters can be displayed on the disabled chat window.
- Fixed a bug where the available mark for taming did not disappear even after completing the Taming quest.

[Item]
- 20 second cooldown is applied to the effect of “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God”. Blood Leech effect is activated again after the cooldown period once it’s activated.


[Others]
- Fixed a bug where when players are resurrected at the Soul Pyre in Kannus Mountains: Herbati Scout Camp, the players are damaged by being resurrected in the air.
- Fixed a bug where when players are resurrected at the Soul Pyre in Navarran Military Camp, the players immediately die upon resurrection by the damage from a fall.
- Fixed an issue where remaining time for item registration was not displayed properly on the “Retrieve” tab in Marketplace
- Fixed an abnormal motion when jumping in the water after falling into the water from a high position.
- Fixed a bug where when it’s refreshed to a new worker when a worker respawns in the Tavern of Estate, the worker list of the Tavern is not matched.
- Fixed some possible causes that can make Attendance not work properly.
- Fixed an issue where it was able to chat with restricted language using a chat macro.
- Changed so that all servers in the ASIA region are now under integrated Matchmaking.
   * Servers:  Baraka, Syrania, Iraphos, Ash’Luha, Kuat Ran


[Dev’s Comment]
▶ “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” Effect Adjustment

As mentioned in the “Letter from PD Koven Park”, we have adjusted the effect of “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God”, one of the accessory items.

Although the “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” is a Rare grade item, its effect level has been unintentionally higher than the other rings with the same grade, as much as the higher grade items.
The need for the effect adjustment was internally mentioned, but it had to be examined thoroughly since many players are already using it.

We prioritized to provide a balanced game play by adjusting the effect of “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” deviated from the intended design, and unavoidably decided to lower the level of the effect.

We hope you understand this unavoidable adjustment for the entire game balance.

The biggest worry and concern from this long decision was that the players who already have the “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” might think the adjustment would be unreasonable for them.

We are going to maximize the rewards to the players with “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” without affecting the game economy.
We ask those players for a kind understanding.


■ Details
- Adjusted Effect
: Blood Leech effect is activated again after 20 seconds(cooldown) from the previous activation.

-Rewards Details
: “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” can be exchanged for a certain amount of Star Seed at “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God Collector” NPC during the exchange period.

- Exchange Period
:September 8th ~ Before September 15th maintenance.

- How to Exchange
: Exchange at “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God Collector” NPC located in Sperios, Carzacor, Navarra, Gnoll Wastes and Tristezza.

- Exchange Price
: The amount of Star Seed will be arranged as long as it doesn’t affect the game economy and quotations.

- Only 1 exchange is available per Character


[Notes]
- The exchange must be done within the exchange period mentioned above.
- “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” cannot be newly obtained during the exchange period.
- It can be obtained again after the update upon the end of the exchange period.
- Limit of obtaining the “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” is to minimize Star Seed inflation that can be caused by exchanging the item to Star Seed.


In addition, we are preparing so that players will obtain an array of useful accessories as mentioned in the “Letter from PD Koven Park”. We will be back soon to let you enjoy the new farming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/dfa488b20d78e7edc72c4c5190edf3ca6a9de88c.png

We will continue to do our best in providing the best gameplay experience.
This announcement will be updated, or a new announcement will be made if additional updates are available.

Thank you.

notes.title: A Letter from PD Koven Park (Part 3) + September 15th (PDT) Update Content
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventures,

In this third Producer’s Letter, I’d like to touch upon in more detail the main updates players can expect on September 15th (PDT). This is something we have been really looking forward to since it will be our first PC update.


Twisted Spider Queen

Twisted field bosses were first introduced through our Final Test, providing a next level field boss experience. To add to the lineup, players can expect to see the new and powerful Twisted Spider Queen (official name Twisted Void Spider Queen) in the upcoming update. As one of the more challenging field bosses, players will now be able to enjoy new combat strategies with the Twisted Spider Queen.

About the Twisted Spider Queen

 The Twisted Spider Queen has a base level of 42, which is significantly higher than the normal Spider Queen, indicating its difficulty.
 Aside from the name difference, the Twisted Spider Queen also showcases a variety of new unique and complicated patterns to provide a different and entertaining combat experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/2b045a5e6589631f4143a9ecbf056ec1531f5609.png


Special Mount Reward
Those who defeat the Twisted Spider Queen will have a chance to obtain the ‘the Wyvern’ mount!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/a94974947cec8013a8ed0755c2781c7662826822.png



Nightspire - Caverns of Wrath

A new Time Dungeon is coming.

To celebrate the release of a new Time Dungeon, the Nightspire - Caverns of Wrath will be available beginning from the week it is released until further notice. Afterwards, it will return to a normal Time Dungeon schedule.

This dungeon was reopened due to Gideon, an important character in the main story, and boasts a concept and difficulty different from existing dungeons.


About the Nightspire - Caverns of Wrath

Background Story
Hundreds of years ago, a dimensional rift was created as a result of an experiment involving  forbidden magic conducted by a group of evil wizards called the Savantis. The rift was sealed by the Warrior King, but recently Gideon, a descendant of the Savantis, broke the seal. This area is now known as the ‘Nightspire’.

Players will need to be at least level 35 in order to enter the dungeon which is divided into 3 areas each guarded by its own boss. 



■ Nightspire Dungeon Video Teaser
[previewyoutube=F8IQJJU3sbE;full]https://youtu.be/F8IQJJU3sbE[/previewyoutube]

First Boss
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/6f0f74f667058f6cadf13d5d2dafef4445bb1d6a.jpg
In an area inhabited by demons mainly employing physical and fire based attacks, awaiting players is a hidden powerful monster not found in other dungeons. Having been imprisoned for a very long time, his wrath will be unlike any other boss players have ever seen.

Second Boss
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/b39476cce2835d656dfc16cfc3a21a87eb183ef8.jpg
Once human, Krauss is now a subordinate of the demons, leading an army of undead. Defeat Krauss’ right hand, The Bonehoarder, and his army of undead to make your way to the throne of spears where he awaits.

Final Boss 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/d3d18daf9dbe1076d2ccd90f13bf7f2120b84d86.jpg
Welcome to Flame Lord Vale’s residence, which features a lake of lava inhabited by a lava spirit. In order to pass through an area with constant lava surges, players will need to put their control abilities to the test. At the end, be prepared to face Flame Lord Vale, whose mighty power will make even the proudest cower in fear.

Special Mount Reward
Those who conquer the new Nightspire dungeon will have a chance to obtain'Ebony Unicorn' mount!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/f5efd5f027399c2dcb51bd5f699bb4481a3db09d.png


Catch our official live broadcast on September 10th for more information!

Through these letters, I hope that I was able to effectively communicate the thoughts and directions of all of us at Round 8 Studio.

To further our efforts in communicating with our players, we will be hosting a live broadcast on September September 10th 3AM (PDT) / 12PM (CEST). Although the broadcast will be conducted in Korean, the main points covered will be shared in a separate announcement afterwards for all our players.

Please leave your questions to the devs by September 6th (PDT) and we will handpick a few to answer during the livestream!

 - Round8 Studio Discord > Dev’s HOTLINE> Question-to-the-devs 
 - https://discord.com/invite/round8studio

I hope we’ll see you there at the broadcast, and we’ll continue to put forth our best in communicating with our players so we can build and improve Bless Unleashed together.

notes.title: Regarding Changes to the Time Dungeon Rewards
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

On August 26th (PDT) modifications were made to the Time Dungeon rewards as a response to the use of specific unauthorized programs. We would like to apologize to 
our players who were playing the game normally but were affected by this change.

As our main focus was to quickly resolve the situation, we ended up deciding to reduce the Time Dungeon rewards and introduced a time requirement. Unfortunately this not only inconvenienced those exploiting the game, but also players who were playing the game as intended. Our goal was to quickly provide a response to the situation, but it ended up negatively affecting the Time Dungeon experience, and for this reason we would like to send our sincere apologies.

We aim to revise the current measures applied to the Time Dungeon within this week. The plan is to revert all the reward lists to their previous state, and this will be applied to the game through an update made by the upcoming Friday. Preparations have also been made to respond to the threat of unauthorized programs with a different approach. However the time requirement for the Time Dungeon rewards will remain until we are able to confirm the effectiveness of our new response method against unauthorized acts. We ask for your understanding of this decision.

Once again we apologize for the inconvenience caused by our last patch, and as a token of our apology we will be offering the following items to all our players. 

5,000 Artifact Cores
Time Dungeon Reward Booster x3
20 Common Bless Breath for your class (5 for each Combat Blessing)
※ Reward items will be delivered in succession through in-game mail beginning from today to tomorrow.
The reward may only be obtained by one character in each account.
The reward mail will expire in 7 days.

We will continue to do our best to provide the best gameplay experience, and will take heed to prevent a similar situation from ever occurring again.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Delayed] August 17th - Update Plans Regarding Current Main Issues
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

Please check out the details below on some of the current ongoing main issues in the game as well as our update plans. 

1. Regarding the Priest Class Patch on August 15th 

 When equipping the Priest Blessing 'Mark of the Wolf', the retribution skill will be changed to receive the HP consumption effect only once when cast.
 Originally, a bug preventing HP from decreasing was found, and a patch was carried out on August 15th.
 However, we found out afterwards that the HP was being decreased several times unintentionally, so a patch to fix this bug is currently being prepared.

 While we were looking into this issue, there needed to be a rebalance for the “Shield of Faith” skill.
 We are currently modifying so that a protective shield effect will easily be activated in a desired stage, will last longer to improve convenience, and won’t be used unlimitedly.

2. A found bug where the “Overwhelming Defense” effect is not applied when the Crusader’s passive skill “Impervious” is activated will be fixed.

3. We are already aware that players are having issues defeating the Bone Dragon due to a lag issue occurring during combat.

 A technical review is currently ongoing to fix this issue with top priority, and we will make efforts to provide excitement of defeating the Bone Dragon in a stable gaming environment.

4. Regarding restricting an advertisement for Star Seed selling websites.

 Buying/selling Star Seeds with real money is strictly prohibited in Bless Unleashed PC. We are aware that players are not able to experience a normal chatting service due to repeated advertisements by some Star Seed selling websites.
 We will continue to monitor those characters with real money trading chats 24/7 applying a penalty of an account ban for maximum 30 days. We are also internally preparing to enhance a chat filtering system against the real money trading chats.


Please note that from the issues mentioned above, #1 and #2 will be updated through the August 18th maintenance, and #3 and #4 will be updated as soon as possible.

We will always make efforts to listen to user feedback and provide a better service and gameplay experience.

=======================================
[2021.08.18]
- The current fix for the upcoming patch is taking a little longer than expected, so please note that the maintanence mentioned above will be delayed by one day. (August 19th)
We ask for your understanding as we are working on fixing the issues as fast as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Bless Unleashed PC: Awakened Update PREVIEW!!
notes.notes:
First, we would like to thank everyone for their interest in the upcoming Bless Unleashed PC Final Test happening from May 12th - May 16th (PDT) / May 13th - May 17th (CEST).

Today, we’ll be visually diving into the main update topics that users can experience during the Final Test.

Keep on reading to check out the updates below!

Moreover, please note that anyone can participate in the upcoming Final Test through the Steam Playtest function, so please head on over to the Final Test participation guide for further details.
 
[Bless Unleashed PC Final Test Participation Guide]

Let’s get started! 


“Enhanced Combat Through the Updated Skill System”

The development team is constantly working to provide a more unique and dynamic combat experience depending on the skills of each class and blessings, while providing a fundamental change in the combat system.

As mentioned in the previous posts, through this update, each blessing will have a unique combat mechanism, and character operation will differ based on the equipped blessings. Moreover, skills can be acquired through character level regardless of blessings. Users can expect an updated combat system through the diverse combination of skills and combos.


Updated Blessings
The updated blessings will each have unique buffs that can be strengthened as the level increases. 

https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/_wxp0i1R1dBk-g4mn5vilUza2DZgrNoc8Q3Os5l-7qskOcVDjvpueHXvg-Hmh8_VlNzkgWdpRCKN6rDaBB-lJ635z_jULojAvIjZzLXYld7eKNhL58xfmXhGGvi9naPBQss3KELFhttps://lh5.googleusercontent.com/e4rddG0r2-o_TJasTeJNlOOdepk-WWw9qCrw2V_d3KTGgJXGNov_c3OKmGWy9auJuyBmO4PhUyibUWTLF3DUXQVfBi1gAB0_ASUoG1PszTWOiDo7azsTMP6DRANJrVgABI78PmTC

Experience a smoother combat flow even after using dodge!

Through this update, the combo phase will not break even when using dodge in the midst of a combo. This change will be applied equally to specific skills, and we believe users will be able to experience an even smoother combat flow than before.


[Crusader - Combo / Dodge / Skill Combination]

https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/TlORYISpVBdsrQEnDiwmQ0xxthW7WRQ2uI0bqvx695Cgs4Ko13pCPHD-IrLVdfrIMe9aUKFyVwvtYf8B7QjNKjwp5pW0UaxLgTsTtYF-nd6KAEJzwDE3-WVSmErpdeaIGrZlca5y

“Further Improved UI/UX for PC Optimization”

1) Control Improvements 

Because Bless Unleashed PC was developed based on a console service, we felt a need to further improve the operational convenience to be better suited for PC users using the keyboard and mouse.

For example, users previously had to use both the keyboard and mouse when navigating through the menu. Through this update, the menu has been improved so that the majority of operation can be done with just the mouse. We plan to further improve PC optimization by allowing more operations to be done with the use of the mouse.


[Improved mouse utilization in the store UI - switch windows using the mouse]

https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/auFhYjYCVhHWVCQX6NSKVRA7CFdY0khrJj94pv_yAZgg38MkABhahVfnaMn8hNqI7hcWgLBp1he-W6U3JaHhRoCuZxt66McBWFhbMhwjOePbvY27R5iIAJJiehxMz_QOBMWdEgZB

In addition, the Hold (long press) operation has been further improved. We recognized that using the mouse for the Hold operation was extremely inconvenient in the PC environment, and although it is difficult to delete the Hold operation entirely, we are working to improve this operation in the following ways.

[Shortened duration of the Hold button / Addition of the Hold button description]
https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/npOOuLfwbvZBI-E5vZZr_KSNOH2hN7Yq61FylJ5AVN92E-ld8B0yjamratLItIQ7FV3OroKUwOjdNVT206uuoNlmdcmYCPRNp5DlTlSELYmHryxdrjvVacAPBxoY3P5bLPWtMWuJ

2) UI/UX Improvements

We are also constantly working to improve the UI/UX. For example, a translucent map function will be added so users can easily check the map while on the go. notes.title: Big Changes to Come, Bless Unleashed: Awakened
notes.notes:
Greetings,
This is Koven Park, the PD of Bless Unleashed. 
 
Through the previous CBT, we were able to analyze all user feedback and responses.
Thankfully, we were able to discover how to further improve the game through these feedbacks, and establish bigger goals to create an even better gaming experience. Once again, I would like to thank all the users who participated in the CBT and showed their passion and interest in the game.
 
The development team has been constantly preparing to greatly improve the game and maximize user needs in the wake of Bless Unleashed PC’s launch. The main goal is to improve the depth and quality of combat, to significantly ease growth and economic stress, and to make contact with key contents at a much easier and diverse level than before. Rough details regarding these changes as well as our plans will be explained below.


Why is the Final Test in May?
First, I would like to apologize to all users who have constantly been waiting for the PC launch.
The Round8 development team strives to share deep communication and apply various feedback from users, so we believed it was more important to begin official service after implementing all the positive changes to Bless Unleashed rather than proceeding quickly at the current level. Moreover, we believe the correct path is to meet users through the Final Test with the upcoming updates and collect further feedback.

We believe that users will understand our motive if we explain the upcoming changes as well as our purpose. Therefore, through the upcoming Final Test in May, we will introduce a new Unleashed world.
We will try our best to meet user expectations.

Bless Unleashed’s Revolutionary Change 
As mentioned previously, we will present  more seamless and diverse content, including the transformation of Bless Unleashed’s combat system and  a better optimized PC environment.
Based on user feedback, we plan to share our development progress on a weekly basis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/a0f08723dda095a20c167c71a9409cc7e1e480f4.png

Listed below are the three major development directions we are currently working on.
 
"Increasing skill and class personality to maximize combat enjoyment"

 Strengthen class propensity + significantly change the bless system for strategic skill management
 Strengthen continuity of combos and skills, and provide a smoother dodge by expanding action cancel
 Deeper character action, extended and smoother character growth

 
For example, the characters of each class will be enhanced by the ability to add or change class unique skills, allowing users to customize skills they would like to use. Users can organize their desired combination of skills without being limited to blessings, and depending on the blessings equipped, the strength, usability and skill combos will change.

In addition, a variety of item effects will be opened, a combination that can be equipped with specialized blessings/skill specific option composition will be created, and the stress of enhancement will be greatly relieved by reinforcing items and reducing hurdles in collection.

Moreover, there will be a big change based on user feedback given about the cut off of combo. Skills for resource replenishment and buff skills can be cast in the middle of the combo, and dodge will not interfere with connecting combos. This will result in a faster overall flow of combat and easier skill dodge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/f3f42c81e60b5176daa24eb2ffdeea46d308adcd.png

"Providing UI/UX optimized for the PC platform, enhancing the convenience of in-game communication between global users:

 Enhancement of keyboard + mouse operation for better convenience
Chat update to align with our global one build 
Addition of an expression method other than text

 
Among the inconveniences identified by previous CBT feedback, we placed the highest  priority on improving keyboard & mouse operation and applying all related improvements. Because Bless Unleashed started off as a console service, we are aware of the various inconveniences experienced in PC and are making improvements that can be provided in a form suitable for the PC environment as much as possible.
In addition, we recognize there are some difficulties in communication from chatting to community and plan to make overall communication easier.
 
There are many more points of improvements that we plan to share in future detailed posts.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/9215605e65313456b42e1073ca4dcb12c2cfdde1.png

“Make existing content more fun, comfortable, and challenging while delivering new additional content”

Appearance of more enhanced Unique Bosses
Supplementation of quest production and contents to increase game immersion
Strengthen convenience of dungeons
Additional content from new experiences

 
In the case of main content, the most important point is to improve participation methods, such as the difficulty level, the low playtime, and the need to wait for matchmaking. More opportunities will be made available to improve the experience with Unique and Elite Bosses, and we are also planning on adding new monsters and dungeons to provide equipment with the various effects mentioned earlier.  

Dungeon matchmaking will become easier, rewards will be more powerful, and the difficulty level will be subdivided. A challenging dungeon will be an opportunity to earn more valuable items, which will further reduce accessibility restrictions so many users can access key content.

Due to the many changes mentioned above, March will consist of sharing the overall changes of the combat system, UI/UX, and content. From April, we will further explain the changes in more detail through CM streams, videos, and screenshots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/3b45e4895d6e385bab73ef1b3aeac298f515463e.png

Round8 considers user communication to be the most important factor.
We are continuously communicating with Bless Unleashed users and are working hard to collect questions and communicate various topics through our Dev Discussion content shared on our community channels.
We will continue to listen and actively reflect on user feedback.
The development team will also continue to develop the upcoming updates for a better gaming experience.
 
We look forward to your continued support, and please make sure to check out the updated post regarding Bless Unleashed: Awakened #1 Combat! [link]


Thank you.
